note: P4099 (Pro 18:24) — a man of many companions may come to ruin; a friend sticks closer than a brother. (raa 'ruin' = standalone.)

dims.v: faithful friendship — a friend closer than a brother
the faithful friend who sticks closer than a brother, unlike shallow companions who bring ruin
(the many companions who fail, by contrast)
the steadfast love that outdoes even kinship

aheb (love/friend) — 'there is a FRIEND who sticks closer than a brother'; against a crowd of shallow companions (who bring ruin), one faithful friend, closer than kin. The depth of true friendship (cf 17:17). Love that cleaves.
